user.title: Control4 Keypads
user.description:
Adds a keypad editor and services for Control4 Square keypads joined to ZHA. Found {count} supported keypad(s).

After adding, open **C4 Keypads** in the sidebar (or press Configure here) to set up each keypad's caps and buttons.

The keypad support itself comes from the ZHA quirks bundled with this integration. If Home Assistant isn't loading them yet, a repair will tell you how to set that up.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Control4 Keypads is already set up.
abort.zha_not_set_up: Set up the Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) integration first.

start_dimming.name: Start dimming
start_dimming.description: Start fading a light up or down until Stop dimming is called. Lights on a Control4 keypad use the keypad's own smooth fade; other lights are stepped.

full_range_ms.name: Full range time
full_range_ms.description: How long a fade from off to full would take. Lower is faster.

stop_dimming.name: Stop dimming
stop_dimming.description: Stop a fade started with Start dimming and keep the current level.

send_command.name: Send keypad command
send_command.description: Advanced: send a raw Control4 command to a keypad, e.g. c4.dmx.led 00 05 ff0000.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command text only, without the frame type and sequence number (send c4.dmx.bmc 00, not 0g0042 c4.dmx.bmc 00).

not_a_keypad.message: That device is not a supported Control4 keypad.

quirks_not_loaded.title: Control4 keypad quirks are not loaded
quirks_not_loaded.description:
ZHA isn't loading the Control4 quirks that come with this integration, so keypads won't work properly.

Add this to `configuration.yaml` (or change your existing `custom_quirks_path`), then restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
zha:
  custom_quirks_path: {path}
```

quirks_other_path.title: Control4 keypad quirks are loaded from another folder
quirks_other_path.description:
ZHA is loading Control4 quirks from `{current}` rather than from this integration. Settings made in Control4 Keypads may not apply, and updates won't reach your keypads.

Change `custom_quirks_path` in `configuration.yaml` to:

```yaml
zha:
  custom_quirks_path: {path}
```

Then restart Home Assistant. You can delete the old quirk files afterwards.

quirks_outdated.title: Restart needed for the Control4 keypad quirks
quirks_outdated.description: Control4 Keypads was updated, but ZHA is still running the old quirks. Restart Home Assistant to load the new ones.
